judge_notes.opus5: A director bought about $12m of stock in the open market on 23 and 26 October - after the quarter closed and with sight of the launch's first five weeks of enrollment data - into a Q3 revenue bar of $0.28-0.30m that is a placeholder a stocking quarter across five specialty pharmacies can clear several times, with 18.2% of shares short at 12.7 days to cover; the +28 put skew argues the other way but sits on a 1,917-contract chain at 55% of mid, which is not a statement.
judge_notes.opus55: A director bought ~$12m in the open market weeks after Q3 closed, with launch data in hand, into an 18% short and a placeholder revenue bar; the +28 put skew holds p_up down.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Rests on the director's roughly $12m open-market purchase two weeks before the first launch print (Form 4) with a near-zero revenue bar and an 18% short, against a +28 put skew and a 24% rebound.
judge_notes.fable51: A director with board access to the first five weeks of launch data bought ~$12m in the open market two weeks before the first launch print, payer PA listings remove the exclusion tail, and an 18% short with 12.7 days to cover sits under +28 put skew; the patient-start bar is unsourced so sizes stay capped.

baseline.expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

tape_rule: open tape_path only after release_read is written

actions.exit_open: sell (cover a short) at the opening print, market
actions.exit_1000: sell (cover a short) at market at 10:00 ET

actions.exit_close: hold through the session, out at the close
